title: Total Body Powerhouse
description: Full body circuit with wall sit, Hindu push-ups, side plank and walking lunges, 3 rounds

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral steps, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.instructions: Back against the wall, thighs parallel, hold the position

exercises.name: Hindu push-ups
exercises.instructions: Diving movement: swoop down close to the floor then rise in an arc

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.instructions: On one forearm, body aligned, hips high

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.instructions: Advance in continuous lunges, big steps

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift the shoulders, brace your core

exercises.name: Broad jumps
exercises.instructions: Standing long jumps, absorb the landing and repeat

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring the foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
